$comment: "Old Chest" (SebastianSosnowski, Sketchfab, CC-BY 4.0; THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md) for scripts/art/kit/render_kit.py: the vault chest (docs/TREASURE.md TR9), closed (treasure.chest) and open (treasure.chestopen). The model is in metres, so importScale 200 (its 0.94 m length is 188 units); at world scale (unitsPerTile 200) it is 0.94 x 0.58 tiles and 0.58 tall in one cell. Four facings like the wall banner (SE = front toward +X, SW = +Z, NE = -Z, NW = -X; the model's front, the lock plate, faces Blender -Y, which is the game's +Z, so SW is rotZ 0), each with its footprint centre written as the pivot (pivotAt: the closed chest's box centre, so the open lid never moves the pivot); the SE front is lit by the mirrored sun (sunSide -1) like the bookcase's +X face. The open chest cuts the box at z -57 (the lid is the top third), turns the lid 110 degrees back about its rear edge and hollows the wooden box (lid.cavity).
